scenes.text: It's Monday, eight in the morning. Your front desk has fourteen new patient emails.
Each one gets retyped by hand, into an old booking system that can't connect to anything.
That's hours every week. And one typo means the wrong patient record.
OpenAI just released G-P-T six point one Terra. It can use a computer and fill in forms.
Now Sarah's email comes in. The A-I types it into the system. Your front desk checks it, then saves.
Worth testing. Not worth trusting alone. Keep a person on the final click.
Follow. I fix one business process like this every week.
